resume.headline: Marketing Lead (E-commerce & Amazon
resume.summary: Marketing Coordinator and Senior Python Developer with an MBA in STEM Business Analytics and 4+ years organizing e-commerce, B2B, and non-profit growth operations using Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Led a cross-functional team of 5 with copy guidelines, pre-launch quality gates, and weekly executive reporting while scaling monthly marketing budgets from $5K to $20K and growing monthly unit sales from 200 to 1,500. Automated data workflows using Docker, Git, REST APIs, and CI/CD pipelines to cut applicant intake processing time by 40% across 80+ applicants.

employments.title: Marketing Lead (E-commerce & Amazon
bullets: Cut Amazon Sponsored Products cost per order by 28% (ACOS from 35% to 25% ) and lifted CTR 24% by consolidating 14–16 campaigns into 5–6 in two rounds over two weeks, as the monthly marketing budget scaled from $5K to $20K .

Lifted the hero ASIN’s unit session percentage from 1.2% to 3.4% ( 2.8x ) in 8 weeks by iteratively testing main image angles, benefit-led infographics, title copy, and A+ content, and pulling a variant after a 10-day dip.
Grew monthly unit sales from 200 to 1,500 ( 7.5x ) across Amazon, Flipkart, and the company site, running paid ads, listing optimization, and lifecycle email against weekly sales and ACOS targets.

Grew engagement by 230% by running paid Instagram and Facebook campaigns in Meta Ads Manager and managing the brand’s social channels, alongside 3 social posts, 2 blogs, and 2 lifecycle emails a week.

Built the company’s first automated lifecycle email flows (replenishment, abandoned-cart, and post-purchase) in Mailchimp integrated with WooCommerce, reaching 40% open rates on the replenishment flow.
Grew organic search clicks from under 50 to 500 per month in 4–5 months by publishing 12 Search Engine Optimization (SEO) articles.

employments.title: Growth Analyst
bullets: Improved MQL-to-SQL conversion by 34% by building a channel-level attribution model across 15+ B2B campaigns (LinkedIn, email, website, paid search) to identify top-converting channels and reallocate budget.
Generated $3M+ in annual sales pipeline at a 35% average open rate and 12% CTR by tracking and opti- mizing performance across 10+ email campaigns for sales and marketing teams.
Engineered SQL reporting queries joining CRM touchpoints with campaign tables in HubSpot and Salesforce across 15+ B2B campaigns , lifting pipeline visibility by 30% .

employments.title: Marketing & SEO Analytics Intern (Amazon
bullets: Grew organic search traffic by 35% by researching competitors and keywords, then auditing and rewriting Amazon SEO and listing copy (titles, bullets, backend keywords, A+ content) across a 500+ product cata- log .
Improved click-through rates by 18% by writing and iteratively testing Google Shopping and Amazon Spon- sored Products ad headlines and analyzing results to identify top-performing copy.
Automated weekly keyword rank and competitor pricing trackers in Excel and SQL across 500+ SKUs , reduc- ing manual reporting time by 25% .
